scheduledTasks.name: Caldova weekly NSG review
scheduledTasks.description: Read-only review of NSG effectiveness and risky rules in the Caldova resource group.
scheduledTasks.message: READ-ONLY WEEKLY CHECK. Scope only to @@RG@@. Inventory every NSG and effective security rule, identify shadowed, overlapping, unused, or overly permissive rules, and correlate them with current Caldova subnet and service exposure. Do not change Azure. Cite resource IDs and observation time. If effective-rule evidence is unavailable, report the gap and do not declare the network clean.

scheduledTasks.name: Caldova weekly RBAC review
scheduledTasks.description: Read-only least-privilege review for identities that can affect Caldova.
scheduledTasks.message: READ-ONLY WEEKLY CHECK. Scope only to @@RG@@ and its resources. Enumerate role assignments that can affect Caldova, distinguish direct, group-inherited, and managed-identity assignments where evidence permits, flag broad or unused privilege, and recommend least-privilege corrections without applying them. Cite assignment and principal IDs. If group membership or activity evidence is unavailable, state that limitation and never label access compliant by inference.

scheduledTasks.name: Caldova weekly cost review
scheduledTasks.description: Read-only cost, anomaly, and optimization review for Caldova.
scheduledTasks.message: READ-ONLY WEEKLY CHECK. Scope only to @@RG@@. Summarize the last 30 days of actual cost, daily trend, top services/resources, anomalies, budgets, and Advisor cost recommendations. Separate measured cost, forecast, and potential savings; do not add unlike values. Recommend only. If Cost Management data is delayed, empty, or unauthorized, state the exact coverage gap and do not report zero spend as a clean result.

scheduledTasks.name: Caldova weekly capacity review
scheduledTasks.description: Read-only capacity and saturation review for Caldova.
scheduledTasks.message: READ-ONLY WEEKLY CHECK. Scope only to @@RG@@. Review Application Gateway capacity/backend health, Container Apps replicas and CPU/memory/request latency, PostgreSQL compute/storage/connections, reporting VM utilization, quotas, and recent throttling. Separate current saturation from forecast risk and cite timestamps. Do not resize or restart resources. Missing metrics must be reported as unknown, not healthy.

scheduledTasks.name: Caldova weekly CVE review
scheduledTasks.description: Read-only source-to-image-to-exposure CVE correlation for Caldova.
scheduledTasks.message: READ-ONLY WEEKLY CHECK. Scope only to @@RG@@. Load caldova-deployment-evidence and caldova-cve-evidence-contract. Correlate the canonical source commit and dependency/SBOM evidence with the exact deployed portal, healthy API, and latency API image digests; then query Microsoft Defender for Cloud vulnerability findings when available. Rank findings by exploitability, internet exposure, affected runtime path, and business criticality. Never claim 'no vulnerabilities' or 'clean' when any source lockfile, SBOM, digest, registry manifest, Defender scan, or exposure evidence is missing or stale; return INCONCLUSIVE with the missing evidence and next read-only query instead. Do not patch, rebuild, or redeploy.
